lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਅਨੇਰਾ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਪ ਗਏ ਨਿਖੂਟਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dukh aneraa bhai binaase paap gae nikhoot ||1||
lines.translation: Pain, ignorance and fear have left me, and my sins have been dispelled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam kee man preet ||
lines.translation: My mind is filled with love for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਬਚਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਿਆਏ ਮਹਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadh bachan gobi(n)d dhiaae mahaa niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Holy Saint, under His Instruction, I meditate on the Lord of the Universe, in the most immaculate way. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਫਲ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaap taap anek karanee saphal simarat naam ||
lines.translation: Chanting, deep meditation and various rituals are contained in the fruitful meditative remembrance of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar anugrahu aap raakhe bhae pooran kaam ||2||
lines.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord Himself has protected me, and all my works have been brought to fruition. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: saas saas na bisar kabahoo(n) braham prabh samarath ||
lines.translation: With each and every breath, may I never forget You, O God, Almighty Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਅਨਿਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਖਾਨੈ ਅਗਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਅਕਥ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gun anik rasanaa kiaa bakhaanai aganat sadaa akath ||3||
lines.translation: How can my tongue describe Your countless virtues? They are uncountable, and forever indescribable. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen darad nivaar taaran daiaal kirapaa karan ||
lines.translation: You are the Remover of the pains of the poor, the Savior, the Compassionate Lord, the Bestower of Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਟਲ ਪਦਵੀ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: atal padavee naam simaran driR naanak har har saran ||4||3||29||
lines.translation: Remembering the Naam in meditation, the state of eternal dignity is obtained; Nanak has grasped the protection of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਸਘਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾ ਦੀਰਘ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)budh bahu saghan maaiaa mahaa deeragh rog ||
lines.translation: Intellectual egotism and great love for Maya are the most serious chronic diseases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naam aukhadh gur naam deeno karan kaaran jog ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the medicine, which is potent to cure everything. The Guru has given me the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਾਛੀਐ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan baachheeai jan dhoor ||
lines.translation: My mind and body yearn for the dust of the Lord's humble servants.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਹਹਿ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot janam ke lahahi paatik gobi(n)d lochaa poor ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: With it, the sins of millions of incarnations are obliterated. O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my desire. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਮਧਿ ਆਸਾ ਕੂਕਰੀ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)te madh aasaa kookaree bikaraal ||
lines.translation: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, one is hounded by dreadful desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣੰ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gur giaan keeratan gobi(n)d ramana(n) kaateeai jam jaal ||2||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's spiritual wisdom, we sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the noose of death is cut away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮੂਠੇ ਸਦਾ ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh moh moothe sadaa aavaa gavan ||
lines.translation: Those who are cheated by sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment suffer reincarnation forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਮਿਟਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਭਵਣ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: prabh prem bhagat gupaal simaran mitat jonee bhavan ||3||
lines.translation: By loving devotional worship to God, and meditative remembrance of the Lord of the World, one's wandering in reincarnation is ended. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਰ ਰਿਦ ਤੀਨਿ ਤਾਪ ਜਲੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitr putr kalatr sur rid teen taap jala(n)t ||
lines.translation: Friends, children, spouses and well-wishers are burnt by the three fevers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ਦੁਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jap raam raamaa dukh nivaare milai har jan sa(n)t ||4||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam, one's miseries are ended, as one meets the Saintly servants of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਧਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤੇ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਛੋਟਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab bidh bhramate pukaarahi katahi naahee chhot ||
lines.translation: Wandering around in all directions, they cry out, "Nothing can save us!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਗਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਓਟ ॥੫॥੪॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: har charan saran apaar prabh ke driR gahee naanak ot ||5||4||30||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lotus Feet of the Infinite Lord; he holds fast to their Support. ||5||4||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ghar 4 dupade ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaraadh sreedhar saphal moorat karan kaaran jog ||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the Lord of wealth, the fulfilling vision, the Almighty Cause of causes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਮਣ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਅਪਾਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਓਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gun raman sravan apaar mahimaa phir na hot biog ||1||
lines.translation: Uttering His Praises, and hearing of His infinite glory, you shall never suffer separation from Him again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਚਰਣਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਉਪਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: man charanaarabi(n)d upaas ||
lines.translation: O my mind, worship the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੰਤ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਕਾਟਿ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales mita(n)t simaran kaat jamadoot phaas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meditating in remembrance, strife and sorrow are ended, and the noose of the Messenger of Death is snapped. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਦਹਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਅਵਰ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satr dahan har naam kahan avar kachh na upaau ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, and your enemies shall be consumed; there is no other way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar anugrahu prabhoo mere naanak naam suaau ||2||1||31||
lines.translation: Show Mercy, O my God, and bestow upon Nanak the taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||1||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) samarath saran ko daataa dukh bha(n)jan sukh raai ||
lines.translation: You are the Almighty Lord, the Giver of Sanctuary, the Destroyer of pain, the King of happiness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਹਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaahi kales mite bhai bharamaa niramal gun prabh gaai ||1||
lines.translation: Troubles depart, and fear and doubt are dispelled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Immaculate Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਠਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: govi(n)d tujh bin avar na thaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord of the Universe, without You, there is no other place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਪੀ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa paarabraham suaamee japee tumaaraa naau || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Show Mercy to me, O Supreme Lord Master, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਲਗੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev lage har charanee vadai bhaag liv laagee ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, I am attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet; by great good fortune, I have embraced love for Him.
